cases.name: fill-rect-solid
cases.script: x.fillStyle='#3a7'; x.fillRect(5,5,20,12);

cases.name: stroke-rect-thin
cases.script: x.strokeRect(5,5,20,20); x.strokeStyle='#08f'; x.strokeRect(10.5,10.5,10,10);

cases.name: stroke-rect-wide-translucent
cases.script: x.lineWidth=4; x.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,255,0.5)'; x.strokeRect(8,8,22,18);

cases.name: clear-rect
cases.script: x.fillStyle='#c33'; x.fillRect(0,0,40,40); x.clearRect(10,10,15,8); x.clearRect(2.5,30.5,10,5);

cases.name: fill-triangle
cases.script: x.fillStyle='navy'; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(5,35); x.lineTo(20,3); x.lineTo(36,30); x.closePath(); x.fill();

cases.name: fill-evenodd
cases.script: x.fillStyle='green'; x.beginPath(); x.rect(4,4,24,24); x.rect(12,12,24,24); x.fill('evenodd');

cases.name: fill-nonzero-overlap
cases.script: x.fillStyle='green'; x.beginPath(); x.rect(4,4,24,24); x.rect(12,12,24,24); x.fill();

cases.name: fill-circle
cases.script: x.fillStyle='#f80'; x.beginPath(); x.arc(20,20,13,0,Math.PI*2); x.fill();

cases.name: stroke-arc-round-cap
cases.script: x.lineWidth=3; x.lineCap='round'; x.strokeStyle='purple'; x.beginPath(); x.arc(20,20,14,0.3,4); x.stroke();

cases.name: stroke-arc-ccw
cases.script: x.lineWidth=2; x.beginPath(); x.arc(20,20,12,0,1.5,true); x.stroke();

cases.name: stroke-curves
cases.script: x.lineWidth=2; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(3,35); x.bezierCurveTo(10,0,30,40,37,5); x.moveTo(3,5); x.quadraticCurveTo(20,40,37,20); x.stroke();

cases.name: joins
cases.script: x.lineWidth=5; ['miter','round','bevel'].forEach(function(j,i){ x.lineJoin=j; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(4+i*12,30); x.lineTo(9+i*12,8); x.lineTo(14+i*12,30); x.stroke(); });

cases.name: miter-limit
cases.script: x.lineWidth=4; x.miterLimit=2; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(5,10); x.lineTo(35,15); x.lineTo(5,20); x.stroke(); x.miterLimit=10; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(5,26); x.lineTo(30,30); x.lineTo(5,34); x.stroke();

cases.name: caps
cases.script: x.lineWidth=6; ['butt','round','square'].forEach(function(c,i){ x.lineCap=c; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(10,8+i*12); x.lineTo(30,8+i*12); x.stroke(); });

cases.name: closed-stroke
cases.script: x.lineWidth=3; x.strokeStyle='#a0a'; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(8,8); x.lineTo(32,10); x.lineTo(20,32); x.closePath(); x.stroke();

cases.name: global-alpha
cases.script: x.globalAlpha=0.4; x.fillStyle='red'; x.fillRect(4,4,22,22); x.fillStyle='blue'; x.fillRect(14,14,22,22); x.globalAlpha=0.75; x.fillStyle='rgba(0,128,0,0.5)'; x.fillRect(2,24,36,8);

cases.name: transform-rotate-scale
cases.script: x.translate(20,20); x.rotate(Math.PI/6); x.scale(1.5,0.75); x.fillStyle='teal'; x.fillRect(-8,-8,16,16);

cases.name: set-transform-stroke
cases.script: x.setTransform(2,0.5,-0.5,1,10,5); x.lineWidth=1.5; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0,0); x.lineTo(10,0); x.lineTo(10,20); x.stroke(); x.resetTransform(); x.fillRect(30,30,4,4);

cases.name: save-restore
cases.script: x.fillStyle='red'; x.save(); x.fillStyle='blue'; x.translate(10,10); x.fillRect(0,0,10,10); x.restore(); x.fillRect(0,0,10,10);

cases.name: ellipse-and-arcto
cases.script: x.fillStyle='#46c'; x.beginPath(); x.ellipse(15,14,11,6,0.4,0,Math.PI*2); x.fill(); x.lineWidth=2; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(4,36); x.arcTo(36,36,36,20,10); x.lineTo(36,20); x.stroke();

cases.name: colors
cases.script: ['#f00','rgb(0 255 0 / 50%)','hsl(240,100%,50%)','rgba(255,255,0,0.25)','transparent','orange'].forEach(function(c,i){ x.fillStyle=c; x.fillRect(i*6,0,6,40); });
